REAUTH_SAME_NETWORK: Your phone must be in the same Wi-Fi as the mirror, not on mobile data or a guest network.
REAUTH_NO_REDIRECT: Set "redirectURI" in config.js to enable re-authorization.
REAUTH_NO_LAN_ADDRESS: The mirror's network address could not be detected. Set "authHost" in config.js.
REAUTH_INVALID_AUTH_HOST: "authHost" in config.js must be the mirror's private IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.1.20.
REAUTH_INVALID_AUTH_PORT: "authPort" in config.js must be a port between 1 and 65535.
